source_statement.domain: Fixed y,r and eta>0 under the paper standing assumptions; n in N; t>=0; z in phase E x E; tau in Delta_n(t)={0<tau_1<...<tau_n<t}.
source_statement.maps: P_(t,tau) z is the endpoint after harmonic arcs and prescribed reflections. rho_t(tau)_i=t-tau_(n+1-i). K_(t,n)(z,tau)=(R P_(t,tau)z,rho_t(tau)).
source_statement.target: K is a jointly Borel involution preserving phase Lebesgue times ordered-simplex Lebesgue. Thus it is a measurable bijection and supplies the unweighted finite-sector change of variables required after A7.
source_statement.proof: Finite phase compositions are joint Borel; fixed-tuple endpoints preserve phase volume by A6/flow/R. Reversed ordered times form an affine signed permutation preserving simplex measure. Phase reversal/flow inverses and bounce involution give endpoint inverse. A product/skew-product measure argument combines fiber volume with time volume, not separate marginal claims alone.
source_statement.source_reference: A1.E8 and A1.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p4.4, HTML lines3176-3198, with pre-A5 identities and A6 lines3116-3144.
source_statement.no_new_provider_assumptions: All joint Borel, volume, inverse and integrability consequences must be constructed internally from actual formulas and existing96 laws.
source_statement.path_convention: A2 sets jump values post-bounce. A8 literal right-continuous path equality is false at nontrivial jump times. Reverse path equals R original(t-s) off the finite event set; at reversed event times use R original((t-s)-) for the post-jump reversed value, and R original(t-s) for its left-limit. Endpoint values at0,t are unambiguous for strict interior events.
source_statement.zero_cases: n=0: empty tuple singleton with mass1, P=Phi_t, K=R Phi_t. t=0,n>0: empty simplex and zero measure. t=0,n=0: phase R and singleton time coordinate. Rank0: unique phase state with mass1. Zero normal or zero rate does not remove a prescribed event from this deterministic domain.
source_statement.source_notation_correction: Source calls time map linear. For t!=0 it is affine with signed-permutation linear part; its absolute Jacobian remains1. No mathematical source repair needed for the intended volume statement.
